name: 485. Calls that name a batch or a file by id follow request_path_overrides on every base, and bedrock refuses them (resource path overrides) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7085 regression. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream (providerErrorFixtureUrl when it is not on its default address). Every row is skipped otherwise. tkp_ovr_anthropic, tkp_ovr_gemini, tkp_ovr_modelark, tkp_ovr_volcengine and tkp_ovr_replicate are custom providers on those bases whose request_path_overrides move every call that names a batch or a file by id to /moved/<request type>/{batch_id} or /moved/<request type>/{file_id}. The fixture answers only on the moved path with the id in place and records every call for GET /__wire, so a call on the vendor's own path, or one that kept the literal placeholder, is a 404 and fails its row. Rows 1-19 assert each such call the base serves: the gateway's 200 and the one vendor call, its method, path and key name. Row 20 asserts that a bedrock-based provider with such an override is refused when it is written, because Bedrock's ids are job ARNs and S3 URIs and its calls go to signed AWS endpoints. Before TXE-7085 rows 1-19 fail (anthropic batch_retrieve and file_retrieve sent the literal placeholder; every other call ignored its override) and row 20 stored the provider. The rows are structural for the vendors themselves: no real vendor serves a moved path. Run with FEATURE="resource path overrides".

item.name: [EXPECT-400] POST /api/providers: a bedrock-based provider with a file_retrieve override is refused when it is written (resource path overrides)

exec: pm.test('resource path overrides setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.test('the provider is refused with a 400 naming the override, the base and the reason', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('request_path_overrides.file_retrieve is not supported on the bedrock base');

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/providers/harness-bedrock-path-override', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('nothing was stored', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code, res.text()).to.equal(404); }); });
